request.description:
## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shopName` | String | Yes | Official name of the shop | `Rahman Electronics` |
| `shopNumber` | String | Yes | Unique shop/unit number within the market | `GF-A-101` |
| `marketId` | String (UUID) | Yes | ID of the market where the shop is located | `6cac3722-3fe5-49bc-bf8e-15ddc950b732` |
| `memberId` | String (UUID) | Yes | ID of the member who owns or occupies the shop | `b7263200-ff0d-4de5-a32b-29d72e993e89` |
| `monthlyRent` | Number | Yes | Monthly rental amount | `25000` |
| `contractStartDate` | String (ISO 8601) | Yes | Start date of the rental contract | `2026-05-01T00:00:00.000Z` |
| `contractEndDate` | String (ISO 8601) | Yes | End date of the rental contract | `2027-04-30T23:59:59.999Z` |
| `displayName` | String | No | Public or display name of the shop | `Rahman Electronics & Gadgets` |
| `levelId` | String (UUID) | No | ID of the market level/floor | `3e6b6f91-7f3e-4b16-9d7a-c9c8b2f5d7a1` |
| `sectionId` | String (UUID) | No | ID of the market section | `2d1f0c84-0e59-4f45-8f6d-18c39d4e2f12` |
| `shopType` | String | No | Type of shop | `RETAIL` |
| `categoryTags` | Array of Strings | No | Categories associated with the shop | `["mobile", "laptop", "accessories"]` |
| `subType` | String | No | More specific classification of the shop | `ELECTRONICS` |
| `locationDescription` | String | No | Detailed location description within the market | `Ground Floor, Electronics Zone, near Main Entrance` |
| `hasElectricity` | Boolean | No | Whether electricity is available | `true` |
| `hasWaterSupply` | Boolean | No | Whether water supply is available | `false` |
| `hasStorage` | Boolean | No | Whether storage space is available | `true` |
| `hasAirConditioning` | Boolean | No | Whether air conditioning is available | `true` |
| `hasDisplayWindow` | Boolean | No | Whether the shop has a display window | `true` |
| `hasSecurityShutter` | Boolean | No | Whether the shop has a security shutter | `true` |
| `internetConnection` | Boolean | No | Whether internet connection is available | `true` |
| `securityDeposit` | Number | No | Security deposit amount | `50000` |
| `maintenanceFee` | Number | No | Monthly maintenance fee | `2000` |
| `electricityRate` | Number | No | Electricity billing rate | `12.5` |
| `waterRate` | Number | No | Water billing rate | `5.0` |
| `paymentDay` | Integer | No | Day of the month rent is due (1–31) | `5` |
| `gracePeriodDays` | Integer | No | Number of grace days after due date | `7` |

response.name: get cities

item.name: Gate Entry — Generate Token (returns shortCode + qrPayload)

request.description:
Generates a gate entry token.

NEW response fields:
- tokenCode: full ID (e.g. GATE_TOKEN-20260425-A1B2C3)
- shortCode: short human-readable (e.g. G-A1B2C3) — print on receipts
- qrPayload: pre-formatted JSON string — encode directly into QR image

category values: TRUCK, CAR, MOTORCYCLE, MINIBUS

Preview exit fees. Accepts EITHER:
- tokenCode: full long code
- shortCode: short code (G-XXXXXX) — useful for low-res scanners

Returns duration and overstay fee (free for 2 hours, 2000 UGX/hour after).
Finalize exit. Marks token as USED and records GateOperation EXIT.
Returns needsOnboarding flag. If true, redirect user to Onboarding.

Returns needsOnboarding: true for seeded/legacy vendors who have not yet submitted TIN.

IMPORTANT: Response is response.data.data (double .data) due to Axios + ApiResponse wrapper.

After login: if needsOnboarding === true → redirect to /onboarding/setup-shop before showing dashboard.
Returns [{ id, name }] list of all markets. Use id as marketId in Setup Shop.

formdata.description: OPTIONAL — floor UUID from market.levels[]. Auto-assigned if omitted.
OPTIONAL — PREFILLED & LOCKED. Logic: 1. Use seeded stall rate if exists. 2. Fallback to market averageRent. 3. Default to 0. Admins can override later via RentContract.

request.description:
Hardened onboarding — MUST use multipart/form-data (not JSON).

Side effects on success:
1. Creates 12-month RentContract
2. Generates initial RentInvoice (due 7 days)
3. Sends HIGH-priority KYC notification to Market Masters

levelId: fetch from GET /markets/{{market_id}} → .levels[]. If omitted, first level is auto-assigned.
Supplier onboarding — same TIN enforcement as Setup Shop. Multipart/form-data required.

Returns full market detail for onboarding prefill:
- name → display as locked field
- averageRent → prefill Monthly Rent (locked)
- securityDeposit → locked
- monthlyMaintenanceFee → locked
- levels[] → use for Level/Floor dropdown
- sections[], gates[] → for gate terminal config

Set {{market_id}} from the Get Markets call above.

Same as Get Market Details — use response.data.data.levels[] to populate the Floor/Level dropdown.
If levels.length === 0, hide the Level field in the onboarding form.

Response shape: [{ id, levelNumber, levelName }]
Returns all markets. Replaces superadmin.getMarkets() mock. Used in admin dashboards and vendor dropdowns.

Returns notifications for the logged-in user.
Market Masters will see KYC_PENDING notifications when vendors submit TIN.

Fields: id, title, message, type, priority (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), isRead, createdAt
Marks a single notification as read. Set {{notification_id}} from Get All Notifications.

Admin-side rent recording (receipt-first model).

NOTE: processRentPayment() in api.ts now maps to this endpoint automatically.
Vendors cannot self-initiate payments — admins record on their behalf.
